Play tip · Any

Sell your cards — your collection progress is permanent

Selling a collectible card never removes it from your Collections registry — sets complete and trophies count whether or not you still hold the physical card. So sell freely: commons go for about $20, rare cards for $1,000 or more, and duplicates are pure cash. For 100% you need 15 of the 18 sets (372 cards minimum), not all 480.

Source

Source: GTA 6 Collectible Cards: All 18 Sets and 480 Cards — FullSweep (2026-11-22).
